name: 02474 · Arlington, MA
findings: ZIP 02474 (Arlington) has 114 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (13% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02474 (Arlington) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02474 (Arlington) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 19% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.text: 9 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
